previous_disclosures.section: Risk Factors Summary > Risks Related to Our Business
previous_disclosures.summary: Winning semiconductor business requires a lengthy process and significant expense, which may generate no revenue.

Significant investments in research and development carry the risk of slow or unsuccessful returns, particularly in developing advanced technologies like custom AI accelerators and XPUs; failure to timely develop these or focus on non-adopted technologies could impair competitive position and negatively impact financial results.

current_disclosures.summary: Avago faces significant risks from the unpredictable and lengthy process of winning competitive design wins for custom AI accelerators and network switches, particularly given the substantial resource strain on both Avago and its contract manufacturers when executing multiple major wins simultaneously. To address customer constraints or competitive pressures, Avago may adopt new business models such as the sale or leasing of AI racks/systems based on XPUs, potentially offering alternative financings or deferred payment models. These strategies expose the company to additional costs, credit/default risks, reduced gross margins, and negative impacts on cash flow, while requiring significant R&D investment that, if unsuccessful or focused on non-widely adopted technologies, could impair its competitive position and revenue.

This represents a material change in the company's strategic exposure and risk profile compared to the 2024 disclosure, which focused mainly on R&D investment and design win costs.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks in New Product Development and AI Execution
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD faces intense competition and rapid technological change in the AI market, with significant risks related to developing, qualifying, and shipping new products on time. Delays can cause missed customer design windows, while uncertainty in long-term AI adoption and potential failure to achieve return on investment pose material risks. The company cannot guarantee success against competitors like Nvidia or customers developing internal solutions, and product complexity necessitates successful high-value launches to maintain average selling prices and competitive positioning.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose significant risks associated with substantial investments in R&D for advanced AI technologies, specifically noting that failure to develop products timely or successfully could impair competitive position or adversely affect financial results. AMD highlights the uncertainty in developing and qualifying new products to meet evolving trends, while AVGO specifies the risk of focusing on non-adopted technologies like custom AI accelerators.

sentences.text: If we fail to timely develop new and enhanced products and technologies, if we focus on technologies that do not become widely adopted, or if new competitive technologies that we do not support become widely accepted, demand for our products such as our custom AI accelerators or XPUs and other AI-related products may be reduced.
Increased investments in research and development, or slow or unsuccessful research and development efforts, would have a negative impact on our financial results.

Although we make substantial investments in research and development, we cannot be certain that we will be able to develop, obtain or successfully implement new products and technologies on a timely basis or that they will be well-received by our customers.

We cannot be certain that our ongoing investments in new products and technologies will be successful, will meet our expectations and will not adversely affect our reputation, financial condition and operating results.

comparisons.peer_topic: AI product market evolution and competitive risk
comparisons.peer_summary: Rapidly evolving AI markets and shifting customer spend toward high-end GPUs create uncertainty for Intel's significant investments in AI PCs, data center, and GPU products, with risks that demand may not materialize or that competitors may remain superior.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC identify the unpredictability of AI market evolution and the risk that their significant investments in AI products may be insufficient or fail to generate expected demand. INTC notes the difficulty in predicting markets and the risk that customer spend shifts away from their product focus, whereas AVGO emphasizes the risk that focusing on technologies that do not become widely adopted will reduce demand for its AI accelerators.

sentences.text: If we fail to timely develop new and enhanced products and technologies, if we focus on technologies that do not become widely adopted, or if new competitive technologies that we do not support become widely accepted, demand for our products such as our custom AI accelerators or XPUs and other AI-related products may be reduced.
The markets and use cases for products with AI capabilities have been rapidly evolving, are difficult to predict, and may impact demand for our products.

The significant investments we have made and expect to continue to make to develop products and software to address what we believe will be increasing demand for AI capabilities, most notably in AI PCs but also in the data center and in GPUs, may be insufficient, and we face significant hurdles, including whether demand will materialize, whether third-party developers will develop the software to utilize the AI capabilities of our products, and whether we will be successful in developing products that can compete with offerings by established competitors.

comparisons.peer_summary: Unsuccessful efforts to develop new memory and storage technologies and products could have a material adverse effect on the company's business, results of operations, or financial condition.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures state that unsuccessful efforts or investments in developing new technologies can have a material adverse effect on business, results of operations, or financial condition. While AVGO specifically cites AI accelerators and XPUs, MU generalizes this to 'memory and storage technologies and products,' reflecting the same core R&D investment risk structure.

sentences.text: We make investments in research and development and the slow or unsuccessful return of our investments could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Unsuccessful efforts to develop new memory and storage technologies and products could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, or financial condition.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks associated with R&D investments and new product monetization
comparisons.peer_summary: Investments in markets with limited operating history may not produce revenue for years; failure to develop or monetize new products, obtain design wins, or bring valuable technologies to market could harm financial results.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies warn that investments in R&D, particularly in markets with limited operating histories or new product lines, may not produce meaningful revenue and that failure to develop or monetize these new products could adversely affect financial results. AVGO links this to the risk of developing advanced technologies like AI accelerators, while NVDA highlights the specific failure to obtain design wins or achieve widespread adoption.

sentences.text: We make investments in research and development and the slow or unsuccessful return of our investments could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
In order to remain competitive, we have made, and expect to continue to make, significant investments in research and development.
We have invested in research and development in markets where we have a limited operating history, which may not produce meaningful revenue for several years, if at all.
If we fail to develop or monetize new products and technologies, or if they do not become widely adopted, our financial results could be adversely affected.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks in new product area investments and R&D failure
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm's growth depends on extending technologies into new areas like automotive and IoT, but investments may not generate expected income, succeed due to patent/standard uncertainty, or yield returns due to underestimating costs, overestimating revenue, or long design cycles in regulated industries.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and QCOM disclose that research, development, and investment efforts in new or expanded product areas (such as AI for AVGO and automotive/IoT for QCOM) may not generate expected operating income or results of operations. Both emphasize that the outcome of these significant investments is uncertain and could fail to meet expectations.

sentences.text: In order to remain competitive, we have made, and expect to continue to make, significant investments in research and development.
Increased investments in research and development, or slow or unsuccessful research and development efforts, would have a negative impact on our financial results.

Our research, development and other investments in these new and expanded product areas, industries and applications, and related technologies and products, as well as in our existing technologies and products, and new technologies, may not generate operating income or contribute to future results of operations that meet our expectations.
